high_level_description: The image features one person, a woman standing in the foreground. She has long, dark hair that falls past her shoulders. Her attire consists of traditional South Asian clothing: A kameez (a long, fitted tunic) with intricate floral embroidery in light pink and beige tones. A dupatta (a decorative scarf) draped over her left shoulder, matching the kameez in color and design. White pants with subtle patterns, likely part of the ensemble. She is accessorized with: Earrings that appear to be dangling and ornate. Bracelets on both wrists.
